summary: The next question to ask is, "Whose science?" The National Reading Panel ignored massive observable patterns in good reading as "science" was only defined as stuff with numbers....literally, thousands of hours of observation research on teaching practice was ignored.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
The next question to ask is, "Whose science?"

The National Reading Panel ignored massive observable patterns in good reading as "science" was only defined as stuff with numbers....literally, thousands of hours of observation research on teaching practice was ignored.
